name: CHEK1 + REDOMA
description: CHEK1 and REDOMA perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 20, 2026, starting at 10 PM.
longDescription:
CHEK1 and REDOMA are scheduled to perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event takes place on November 20, 2026, with a start time of 10 PM.

The concert has a duration of 120 minutes. Tickets are priced at €10, with tickets at the door costing €12. The age rating for this event is 16 and over.
